facts.text: The opera received its world premiere at the National Theatre in Brno on 18 December 1926, conducted by František Neumann.

facts.text: The Makropulos Affair (also The Makropoulos Case, The Makropulos Secret, or in Czech: Věc Makropulos, lit. 'The Makropulos Thing') is a Czech opera in 3 acts, with music and libretto by Leoš Janáček.
